changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS calls ( id BIGINT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, user_id BIGINT NOT NULL, sport VARCHAR(50) DEFAULT 'NFL', team VARCHAR(100), penalty_name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, rule_reference VARCHAR(255), controversy_level INT DEFAULT 1, notes TEXT, timestamp TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE );
